findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 368 requests to 99 third-party domains (median of 3 passes).
Of 34.9 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 31.1 MB (89%) came from third-party domains, 2.9 MB of it from services classified as tracking (267 requests).

58 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: 1rx.io (RhythmOne (Magnite), advertising), 360yield.com (Improve Digital, advertising), 3lift.com (TripleLift, advertising), adform.net (Adform, advertising), adnxs.com (Microsoft (Xandr), advertising), ads.linkedin.com (LinkedIn, advertising), adsrvr.org (The Trade Desk, advertising), adtrafficquality.google (Google, advertising), amazon-adsystem.com (Amazon, advertising), appier.net (Appier, advertising).
148 cookies were set by third-party domains (192 cookies in total).
The main document response did not include a Content-Security-Policy header or meta tag.
